decks.notes: The deck focuses on generating mana quickly through cards like Lion's Eye Diamond and Lotus Petal, as well as rituals like Cabal Ritual and Dark Ritual, in order to build up a storm count and cast a lethal Tendrils of Agony. It also utilizes cards like Urza's Bauble and Mishra's Bauble to draw cards and keep the combo going. Veil of Summer protects against disruption while cards like Thoughtseize help disrupt the opponent's game plan. Urza's Saga can help find key combo pieces, and Gaea's Will can provide a second wind if the combo is disrupted.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize the cascade mechanic by casting cards with the "Cascade" ability, such as Violent Outburst and Crashing Footfalls. By doing so, the deck aims to generate a card advantage and overwhelm the opponent through aggressive plays. Additionally, the deck incorporates a mix of control elements, including counterspells like Force of Will and card draw with Fire / Ice. The inclusion of Simian Spirit Guide and Elvish Spirit Guide allows for explosive starts and the deck also includes a variety of lands to provide the necessary color requirements for casting spells.

The deck has a strong mana acceleration with cards like Dark Ritual and Lotus Petal to quickly cast spells. It includes a mix of creatures like Witherbloom Apprentice and Orcish Bowmasters to control the board and win the game through attrition.
